 Game Preview: Warriors at Rockets - 11/11/26
 Kalyb Champion Writer & Digital Content Coordinator November 10, 2026 3:12 PM PST WARRIORS BEGIN FIVE-GAME ROAD TRIP AGAINST ROCKETS 
The Warriors begin a five-game road trip in Houston, facing Kevin Durant and the Rockets at Toyota Center on Wednesday. The Dubs enter Wednesday’s game on an eight-game winning streak and have the same record as the Rockets: 8-3. Houston began its season by winning its first five games and snapped a recent two-game skid with a 10-point win over the Denver Nuggets. 
 Tap To Watch
 LAST TIME OUT 
The Golden State Warriors wrapped up their six-game homestand with a dominant 138-87 over the New Orleans Pelicans on Monday night at Chase Center, bringing their win streak to eight. Stephen Curry (25), Brandin Podziemski (25), and Yaxel Lendeborg (23) paced the offense, combining for 73 points and draining four 3-pointers each. De'Anthony Melton led the reserves in scoring with 16 points and four triples while Charles Bassey recorded his first double-double of the season with 10 points and a game-high 10 rebounds off the bench. The Warriors' 51-point win marks their fourth largest margin of victory in the team's 80th season as a franchise. Continuing to make history, Curry moved up to 16th on the NBA all-time scoring list after sinking a triple in the third quarter for his 26,803 career points, passing Demar Derozan (26,793). »Full Story

Inflammation) and Kristaps Porzingis (Not With Team) are OUT. Team Notes

 COMPELLING NOTE: 
 Warriors:  Stephen Curry needs 25 points on Wednesday to reach 300 points over his first 10 games. Curry is one of two players aged 35 or older to accomplish this feat, having done it in 2023. The other player is Rockets forward Kevin Durant, who also achieved this feat in 2023. 
 Rockets:  Kevin Durant is attempting a career-low 12.3 shots per game and averaging 21.0 points per contest in his 19th NBA season. Durant is fifth on the league’s all-time scoring list and is within 900 points of passing Kobe Bryant for fourth.
